build_inspector: python sieves run after a build; reds a component that fails one (no charter, no proofs, a silent device, ...). "We find a new thing, we add a new sieve." → CodeMother (10.3.5)
plan_inspector: reads charters' own admissions of what they don't yet do, so nothing reads as done while it says otherwise. → CodeMother
diagnostic_inspector: the smart reader of the dumb breadcrumbs base's logging leaves; complete diagnosis on the first pass. → CodeMother? [Q#40: or base, since it reads base's logs?]
corrosion: catches a constraint that stopped constraining with no decision behind it. → CodeMother
exemptions: the declared list of places a check skips something, each with its reason. → CodeMother
rehearsal: the cheapest model reads a ticket cold three times and tries to build it on paper, so "buildable as written" is measured. → CodeMother
